HSC Survey Results

German Bank Survey # 7 Results from 01/11/2026

Survey Details

4 commercial purse seiners conducted this fishing survey on 01/11/2026 starting at 18:30:00.

The Lady Melissa ran two transects in the German Bank box and two transects in the Seal Island box. All other vessels ran three transects in the German Bank box and one transect in the Seal Island Box.

There was no plankton tow or CTD cast conducted.

No tags were applied during this survey.

Samples were obtained for target strength estimation.

Acoustic Equipment

Each vessel was equipped with a Simrad ES38-18/200-18C combi (2-in-1) transducer prior to the survey that contains a 38kHz split beam and 200 kHz single beam transducer. Data was logged to the computer hard-drive for post-processing. All participating boats were calibrated on 38kHz before the survey.

Survey Results

Main Results

The results are subject to change as DFO will re-evaluate data editing, area estimation and apply a target strength. Please note that DFO biomass estimates from 2025 forward are not directly comparable to HSC values due to changes in protocols being applied by the DFO. This will be aligned in the future if/when the protocols are standardized and adopted by both HSC and DFO.

Preliminary biomass prediction for German Bank using standardized parallel transects is 18,802mt, and with turnover applied 9,762mt. The preliminary biomass estimate for Seal Island is 3,642mt.

Vessel Performance

Speed

Average vessel speed was 8.84. This is above the 8 knot requirement; vessels are urged to slow down to prevent backscatter noise from interfering with the acoustic data.

The speed for each transect are rudimentary and are calculated based on distance. If a significant amount of distance is cut, the speed will appear slower.

Distance

No significant distance was cut from the planned lines; vessels covered the planned area well.
